_meta.description: Pinned per-tenant trust roots for the bipcircle-verifier. Each tenant entry binds the verifier to a specific bank-service URL, XRPL issuer account (for the daily attestation tx), KMS public key (by kid pattern), and one or more tokens (per chain). Eliminates the user-supplied-URL trust gap (Pro audit F1+F2). Updates happen via verifier source releases: a tenant onboards or extends to a new chain, the operator opens a PR to this file, a new verifier version cuts, npm publish, verifiers in the field upgrade when the new tenant comes online.
_meta.schemaNotes: v3 adds `reserveCurrency` per token: the fiat currency of the legally segregated CELL the token belongs to (the issuer is a protected cell company — one currency per cell, no cross-cell netting). The verifier groups tokens by reserveCurrency and verifies each cell against ONLY its own currency's bank reserves. `currency` keeps its per-chain meaning: fiat denomination for ethereum tokens, ON-LEDGER TICKER for xrpl tokens (used for gateway_balances). reserveCurrency is REQUIRED for xrpl tokens (their ticker is not a fiat currency); ethereum tokens without it fall back to `currency`, but new entries should always set it explicitly. A token whose cell currency cannot be resolved makes the verdict INCONCLUSIVE, never PASS. v2 introduced tokens[] (array); v1 used `token` (object) — both older shapes still load.
